locations.name: Containment Mezzanine
locations.atmosphere: Every surface is covered in thin scratches — all at exactly eye height.
hazards: residual temporal discharge (sanity drains near the walls)

locations.name: Chapel of Static
locations.atmosphere: Dust hangs motionless in the air, refusing to settle, as if time here has stopped.
hazards: mimic zones: voices here are not who they claim to be
biohazard mist (health drain without a filter)

locations.name: Observation Ward B
locations.atmosphere: Emergency lights pulse like a slow heartbeat; the walls sweat condensation that never dries.
hazards: unstable lighting — the dark comes without warning
the Ancient One patrols this ring every few minutes

dialogue: "The Heart isn't the source. It's the wound. Something else did the cutting."
"Don't trust the version of me that's kind. I've never been kind."
"I counted the screams last night. There were more than there are of us."
"You shouldn't have come back here. It remembers you now."
alienBehavior: K'Thaal update: abandons chases after 20 seconds unless you look back.
storyBranch: The quarantine door is open for the first time. Nobody who enters has aged since.
